paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that renders several live sessions at once in a rows × columns grid
, so two or more workspaces can be watched side by side — and used, not just watched: every pane is
the real conversation, not a thumbnail.
**English** | 简体中文
# Workspace Split View

A DeepSeek Harness Web UI
plugin that renders several **live sessions** at once in a `rows × columns

`
grid, so two or more workspaces can be watched side by side — and used, not
just watched: every pa
ne is the real conversation, not a thumbnail.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features

- **Grid of live conversations** — 1–3 columns × 1–3 rows (up to 9 panes), each
cell showing a real

session with its composer and streaming output.
- **Resizable, per-column layout** — drag a column d

pane's workspace or session, create a session in
that pane's workspace with the shipped new-session

flow, or pop the session
out to the normal conversation view with `↗`. The session list is grouped b

y
workspace (one collapsible branch per workspace, with its session count),
archived sessions never

appear, and a workspace whose sessions are all
archived is hidden from the workspace list too. With

the workspace-categories
plugin installed, the workspace picker follows its category tree (collapsib

le
and nested, unassigned workspaces under *Uncategorized*).
- **Sidebar follow** — while split view

is open, opening a session from the left
sidebar fills a pane instead of replacing the split view.

An inline switch
turns this off when the native behaviour is wanted.
- **In-pane file preview** — fi

le links in a pane open a read-only reader docked
beside (wide pane) or below (narrow pane) that pan

e's conversation, with a
draggable divider, text line numbers and paging, inline images, and
*Open w

ith default app*.
- **In-pane changes review** — the *edited files* summary at the end of an answer

opens the same dock as a review: the turn's changed-file list with line counts
and the unified diff

of the selected file.
- **Remembers your layout** — tracks, sizes, assignments and the follow switch

live in `localStorage` under `dsh.workspace-split.v1`.
- **English and Chinese UI** — every visible
string is localized.
## Compatibility
| Requirement | Value |

| Harness runtime | `>= 0.2.1-rc.3` (`engines.dsh`) |
| Harness UI | Web (`platform: "web"`), deskto

p or browser |
| React | supplied by the Harness client module table |

The pane renders the shipped chat view and reads a few client services
(`sessions`, `slots`, `locale

`, `workspaces`, `layout`, optional `remote`,
`sidebarRight`, `uiWorkspace`). They are part of the r

eleased client API, but a
future Harness may rename them; `engines.dsh` states the tested range, and

the
plugin fails closed (a per-pane note, not a broken shell) when one is missing.
## Install
### From a plugin market

1. In the Harness Web UI open **Plugins → Discover**.
2. Add the market index URL that lists this pl

ugin, find **Workspace Split
View**, and press **Install**.
3. Restart DeepSeek Harness so the profi
le reloads its bundles.
### With the `plugin_manager` tool

Ask the agent to run `plugin_manager` with `install_bundle`, target
`dsh-plugin-workspace-split` (re

gistry install) or the absolute directory of a
checkout (development `link:` install). Enable the bu

ndle if the profile keeps
it disabled, then restart.
### From a checkout (development)

Run `plugin_manager` with action `install_bundle` and the absolute path of this
directory as the tar

get (the profile keeps it as a `link:` dependency), enable
the bundle if your profile leaves it disa
bled, then restart Harness.

No build step: `client.js` is a plain browser module and `index.js` is an empty
Host entry point.
## Uninstall

Disable or remove the bundle in **Plugins**; the grid panel disappears and the
main column returns t

o the single conversation view. Removing the package from
the profile also removes the sidebar panel

button. Your `localStorage` layout
key can be deleted independently.
## Usage

1. Click the four-pane grid icon in the left sidebar's panellist (below
*Plugins* / *Schedules*) to

open **Split view** in the central column.
2. Pick `Columns` and `Rows` (1–3 each). The first time a

pane appears it shows
[该节后续省略]
## How it works

The plugin is one client module (`client.js`) plus one Host row. The panel
mirrors the shipped `main
` → `main.conversation` chain:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Each pane retains one Session reference and binds it with the `SessionProvider`
standard seat, so an

embedded conversation follows its own session instead of
the one selected in the main column. The l

ayout is a CSS grid whose
`grid-template-columns` come from persisted fractions; dividers are absolu

tely
positioned and driven by pointer events with keyboard equivalents.

Two shipped surfaces assume the right Sidebar is mounted, which it is not while
a global panel occup

surfaces assume the right Sidebar is mounted, which it is not while
a global panel occupies `main`:

- a file link calls `sidebarRight.openResource("dsh-resource://file/…")`;
- the edited-files card ca

lls `sidebarRight.openResource(
"dsh-resource://changes-review/session/<session>/<seq>/<turn>", {par

ht.openResource(
"dsh-resource://changes-review/session/<session>/<seq>/<turn>", {params:{index}})`.

The plugin wraps `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource`: a file address becomes the
in-pane reader, a chang

es-review address becomes the in-pane review (reading the
shipped tab's own same-origin routes `api/

changes.summary` and
`api/changes.diff`), and every other address or error keeps the shipped
behavio
ur. Both docks are read-only and keep the conversation visible.
## Limitations

- While a global panel is active the right Sidebar is unmounted, so its tabs are
unavailable; this p

lugin covers the two click paths above, not every
sidebar-dependent action.
- Follow mode intercepts

session switches; use a pane's `↗` or the toolbar
switch to reach the native single-conversation be

haviour.
- Review diffs are read-only and show one file at a time.
- The Harness client services use

d here are released API, not a formal stable
contract; a Harness upgrade outside the declared range

may need a plugin
update.
